description:
Create a classification rule.

Provide description_pattern (regex matched case-insensitively against
the transaction description), category, and subcategory. Optionally add
amount_operator (lt, lte, gt, gte, eq, neq) and amount_value to filter
by amount. When the compound constraint matches, category, subcategory,
and optionally description (new_description) are written.

amount_operator.description: Optional amount test: lt, lte, gt, gte, eq or neq; empty for no amount test.

amount_value.description: Signed amount in dollars the amount_operator compares against (negative for money out); required when amount_operator is set.

description_pattern.description: Regular expression matched case-insensitively against the transaction's description, merchant and description override.

dpop_token.description: Proof that the caller holds npub. Either the grant envelope that receive_npub_proof returned, or the raw JSON of a kind-27235 Nostr event signed by npub: content "", a `u` tag holding this tool's exact name from tools/list, created_at within 60 s of now, and a random `nonce` tag.

new_description.description: Replacement description written onto matching transactions; empty leaves descriptions as they are.

npub.description: The patron's Nostr public key (npub1...). Tool fees are paid from this patron's balance; dpop_token proves the caller holds it.

session_id.description: TaxSort session id to scope the rule to that session; empty makes it a global rule for all your sessions.

name: taxsort_save_rule
title: Save a classification rule
